title: Bigger Brother
tagline: Political campaign promises stored on the blockchain. Permanently.
description: Our project is a political truth-tracking platform designed to provide users with real data on politicians. It allows you to discover, analyze, and hold politicians accountable for their campaign promises and actions, promoting transparency and informed decision-making in politics.
how_its_made:
Three.js - react-three-fiber - Next.js - TailwindCSS for the frontend.

`````Nft.storage ```+ helia are used to upload the politician and the evidence of their promises onto the ````ipfs blockchain `

`Solidity smart contract is used to keep track of the CID of the politician and the evidence to their campaign. 

WalletConnect to allow users to connect their wallet to the app and submit new evidence and sign with the contract.
